title: Ugucungera abapfuye
intro: Ugiye guhura n’umutima ugeragejwe n’ugutandukana gukomeye cane, amaso yawo yari azi ururimi rw’amarira ariko umutima wawo ntiwigeze utakaza icizigiro. Mu nkuru y’uguhenda, y’uguhahamira, n’ugusubirana amaherezo, uwo musuku w’icubahiro wa Allah yabaye ikimenyetso c’ukwihangana ibihe vyose. Ni nde yihanganiye imyaka y’umubabaro yihishije, gusa akagaruka kubona n’umunezero mu kanya nk’ako gukubita urugohe?
clues: Ndi umuhanuzi izina ryiwe ryacitse ikimenyetso c’ukwihangana mu gihe c’ugutakaza gukomeye.
Narahezagiwe n’abahungu benshi, ariko umwe bamunyaze ishari ry’abandi.
Urukundo nari mfise kuri uwo yazimiye rwari runini cane ku buryo amaso yanje yahindutse yera kubera intuntu, yamara sinigeze nidodomba kiretse kuri Allah.
Nararungitse abahungu banje gusubira kurondera uwo nari naratakaje na mwenewabo, ndabahimiriza kudaheba icizigiro.
Uwuzanye inkuru nziza ashitse, barantera ishati mu maso, maze bukwi na bukwi isi yongera gutomoka.
Nzwi kw’izina rya Isirayeli, kandi mu bahungu banje cumi na babiri ni ho havuye imiryango cumi n’ibiri y’ihanga rikomeye.

arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَ ٱلْبَشِيرُ أَلْقَىٰهُ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦ فَٱرْتَدَّ بَصِيرًۭا ۖ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: And when the bearer of good tidings arrived, he cast it over his face, and he returned [once again] seeing. He said, "Did I not tell you that I know from Allāh that which you do not know?" (12:96)
